segment 1: ring acquisition takes 3.73s of the 20s orbit, so its 360° sweep runs in 16.27s at 22.13°/s instead of the requested 18.00°/s (23% faster). A 24.59s segment would hold the requested rate — the acquisition is 19% of the segment and grows with it, so adding 3.73s is not enough. Staging the arrival removes the acquisition entirely.
